latestVersion.changelog:
KM Video Zero 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create clean, edited videos from completely raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Fast cloud-based processing (30–60 seconds typical per video) with 1080p MP4 output.
- Automatic setup: connects to backend, handles token/session management, informs user when ready.
- Supports uploads, real-time editing instructions, audio/text overlays, export, and credit checks.
- Session-based workflow allows iterative edits and batch processing within a single session.
- Clear error handling and status updates throughout the video creation pipeline.
